g.text: ECOMEMORIES SMART KIOSK — ACCURATE BREADBOARD BLUEPRINT
38-Pin ESP32 Occupies Rows 1 to 19 ONLY • Row 20 is Completely Empty
⚠ ROW 20 IS EMPTY: NO ESP32 PINS PLUGGED HERE ⚠
ROWS 21 TO 30: FREE PROTOTYPING AREA (COMPONENTS & BUZZER)
⚠ NEVER power printer from ESP32 VIN
a18 (VIN) ➔ Red Rail (+) • a19 (GND) ➔ Blue Rail (−) • a9 (D25) ➔ Buzzer (+) • a12 (D14) ➔ TRIG / IR OUT • a11 (D27) ➔ ECHO • j10 (TX2) ➔ Printer RX • Row 20 = EMPTY (NO PINS)
